title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
author: Tom Wolfe
summary: Sherman McCoy, a rich Wall Street bond trader, is involved in a hit-and-run in the Bronx. The case pulls in prosecutors, a tabloid reporter and a preacher in 1980s New York.
readIf: you like sprawling, sharp satire about money, race and ambition in a big city.
skipIf: you want likeable characters or a short, quiet novel.
